level: finite fail-closed declaration-surface inventory; no semantic execution or machine upgrade

machine.selection: exact dependencies/adva-machine.lock.json revision; later commits and pull requests are excluded

question: Within the unchanged byte-bounded declaration surface of the exact pinned adva-machine commit, does repository-root-anchored selection permit a complete inventory, and if so does the surface declare one executable receiving route with all four obligations: a versioned frozen opaque request or lossless typed equivalent, two checked native diagram admissions, the qualified source/occurrence/path endpoint relation, and a receiver outcome?

objects.required_relation: versioned request -> two checked diagram admissions -> exact qualified source/occurrence/path endpoint check -> receiver outcome
objects.arithmetic_domain: The literal 1/1 remains serialized Rational data. Additive zero, multiplicative unity, inverses, commutation and arithmetic truth are not queried.

selection_grammar.root_anchor_rule: A path matches only when it has the same segment count as the pattern and each path segment matches the corresponding pattern segment. Wildcards never cross slash boundaries and suffix matches are excluded.
selection_grammar.catalog_closure: Every repository-relative file named by spec/catalog.json files, plus the catalog itself.
selection_grammar.exclusions: Directories, symlinks, submodules, evidence snapshots, target products and every path not selected by the exact grammar are excluded. Any selected evidence path is a preflight refusal.

types_and_quantifiers.selected_file: tracked regular blob at the pinned commit
types_and_quantifiers.candidate_line: one UTF-8 line containing at least one frozen search term
types_and_quantifiers.quantifiers: Every tracked regular file selected by the frozen grammar at the one pinned commit, and every candidate line reported from those files. No statement about the rest of the machine tree, later revisions, possible new implementations or runtime behavior.

candidate_grammar.exact_route: One declared executable route exposes a versioned input, checked native diagram admission, qualified source/occurrence/path validation, and a receiver outcome.
candidate_grammar.partial_route: A command, specification or primitive lacks at least one of those four obligations.
candidate_grammar.none_in_surface: No exact route remains after checking every reported candidate in the complete selected surface.

evaluation.success: Retain the complete preflight manifest, exact route, input/output declaration, replay entry and all four obligation witnesses; execute no semantic case in this inventory.
evaluation.bounded_negative: If every selected file is preflight-pinned and every candidate is checked, retain NoExactRouteWithinSelectedSurface together with partial routes and missing obligations.
evaluation.unknown_preflight: Any revision, dirty-tree, file-kind, selection, count, byte, digest or preflight parse failure returns RefusedBeforeSearch and remains Unknown.
evaluation.unknown_search: Any decode, timeout or candidate-limit failure after the manifest is complete returns RefusedDuringSearch, retains the manifest, and remains Unknown.

protected_obligations: This continuation changes only root-anchored selection and refusal-stage reporting relative to the 2026-11-04 contract.
Preflight must refuse before content search when any bound or repository invariant fails.
Python may inventory declarations but cannot create semantic identities or certify native behavior.
A primitive importer, generic request command, documentary transport route or text match is not the required composed receiving route.
Research 0090 coverage remains open; Research 0092 promotion remains blocked; local image equality creates no M6 filler; Research 0123 words remain Proposed.

budget.memory: Measure driver child ru_maxrss when available; do not substitute file size for memory.

word_policy.reason: Existing exact route, partial route, Refused, bounded negative and Unknown vocabulary is sufficient; a declaration inventory is not word learning.

residuals: The selected surface is deliberately narrower than the complete machine repository.
Declaration presence does not establish successful runtime execution; declaration absence outside this surface is not tested.
The merged predecessor is adva history, not independent adva-machine authority.
